aiSettings.placeholder: Select a provider in LLM Switcher
aiSettings.modelFetchNoKey: Please set the API key first
aiSettings.samplingIgnoredForReasoning: Temperature and Top P are not sent to reasoning models
aiSettings.systemPromptHelp: For OpenAI Chat models, this is appended after the built-in instruction "Continue the following text..."
aiSettings.templateHelp: With no template, the system prompt, settings, and body are joined as-is and sent. For models trained to follow instructions (instruct, it, chat versions, etc.), choose the template that matches the model's format. The choice takes effect from the next suggestion.

templateDesc.none: No template; the content is joined as-is and sent. Suited to models that simply continue text (base models, etc.).
templateDesc.gemma4: The Gemma 4 chat format. The model writes the continuation directly in its turn, without thinking.
templateDesc.gemma4-think: The Gemma 4 chat format. The model thinks first, then writes the continuation. The thinking is kept apart from the text.
templateDesc.chatml: ChatML (the format delimited by <|im_start|>). No instruction to stop thinking is added.
templateDesc.chatml-nothink: The ChatML format with an empty thinking block placed first, so the model writes the continuation without thinking.

aiSettings.templateCustomNote: A custom template is written in sumire.json. Edit its contents in sumire.json. Choosing an option here replaces the custom template.
aiSettings.templateCustomInvalidNote: The custom template in sumire.json has a problem, so no suggestions will be generated as it is. Fix it in sumire.json, or choose an option here.
aiSettings.templateUnreadableNote: The template setting in sumire.json can't be read, so no suggestions will be generated as it is. Fix it in sumire.json, or choose an option here.
aiSettings.templateTagsAdded: Added the tags that separate thinking from the text (<|channel> and <channel|>) to the thinking settings.
aiSettings.templateThinkingDisabled: Thinking separation is turned off, so the thinking text will be mixed into suggestions. Turn it on with thinking in sumire.json.
aiSettings.templateMaxTokensHint: Thinking counts toward Max Tokens. A suggestion can come back empty when thinking is cut off, so we recommend raising it to {{min}} or more.
aiSettings.templateConfirmBody: The current template written in sumire.json will be replaced with the option you chose. To get it back, you'll need to edit sumire.json.

llamaServer.modelsEmpty: No models. Set the models folder in the AI settings.
llamaServer.extraArgsHelp: One argument per line. For an argument that takes a value, put the name and the value on separate lines (e.g. line 1: --flash-attn, line 2: on). Takes effect from the next launch.
llamaServer.contextSizeInvalid: Enter the context size as an integer of 1 or more.
llamaServer.modelsDirUnset: Set the models folder to list the gguf files directly inside it here.
llamaServer.modelsDirNoGguf: No gguf files directly inside this folder.
